source.author: Suicasmo
source.scope: Six central upper-storey windows. Clear panes only; original frame pixels excluded by independently inspected inset quadrilaterals. Ground, annex, peripheral windows and obscured lower second-storey panes remain procedural glass.
source.limitations: Single-image glass reflections are fixed to their panes, not dynamic or a multi-view photographic reconstruction. All metre dimensions still estimates. Fine source black-frame boundaries supersede coarse calibration-independent window bounding rectangles, which included adjacent white piers.
source.control_method: Manually inspected original 5184x3456 image; rectified contact sheets used only for reading pane boundaries. Authored normalized bar positions and 2–5px clear-glass margins frozen as explicit raw-pixel quadrilaterals; original JPEG unmodified.
